title: Everything Must Be Perfect
description: Plot: Establish academy social dynamics and expectations | Emotion: Social anxiety and pressure to conform vs. authentic self-expression | Setting: Rainbow Academy Practice Grounds and Common Areas at Afternoon, same day | Characters: Princess Ruby, Princess Luna, Blaze (Ruby's unicorn), Stardust (Luna's unicorn), Academy Students (ensemble)
lyrics:
Every gesture must be graceful
Every word must be just right
Every spell must be precisely cast
Every step must be in time

When you represent your kingdom
When you wear the royal crown
There's no room for almost perfect
You can never let them down

Everything must be perfect
Every moment, every day
Everything must be perfect
That's the only royal way

No mistakes and no excuses
No second place will do
Everything must be perfect
When the world is watching you

I've been training since I could walk
Every lesson learned by heart
Mother says that excellence
Is where true leadership starts

When your family built this academy
When your name is on the wall
You don't get to be just good enough
You have to give your all

Sometimes I wonder what would happen
If I let my guard down for a day
If I made a single error
Would they take it all away?

But I can't afford to wonder
Can't afford to show I'm scared
When everyone expects perfection
I have to be prepared

Everything must be perfect
Every moment, every day
Everything must be perfect
That's the only royal way

LUNA (sung underneath, growing distress):
What if perfect isn't possible?
What if I'm not meant to be
Everything that they expect here?
What if they can't see me?

ALL:
Everything must be perfect
When the world is watching you
stage_directions: Character Development. The academy practice grounds are an impressive outdoor space with multiple training areas. There are obstacle courses for unicorn-princess partnerships, diplomatic simulation spaces with floating platforms, magical practice circles with protective barriers, and performance stages for presentation skills.. Students move between different stations, practicing various princess skills. Everything is designed to showcase talent and achievement - scoreboards track progress, mirrors reflect perfect posture, and magical devices measure precision in spellcasting and movement.
character_notes:
The academy practice grounds are an impressive outdoor space with multiple training areas. There are obstacle courses for unicorn-princess partnerships, diplomatic simulation spaces with floating platforms, magical practice circles with protective barriers, and performance stages for presentation skills.

Students move between different stations, practicing various princess skills. Everything is designed to showcase talent and achievement - scoreboards track progress, mirrors reflect perfect posture, and magical devices measure precision in spellcasting and movement.

The atmosphere is one of friendly competition and high standards, but underneath there's pressure to excel and be seen as worthy of the academy's reputation.
